if: revenue would otherwise be recognised under AS 9 para 11 or 12
at the time of raising the claim it is unreasonable to expect ultimate collection
note: The test is applied at the time of raising the claim, not at period end. A later doubt is a different question and is not covered by this rule.

evidence.quote: If at the time of raising of any claim itis unreasonable to expect ultimate collection, revenue recognition should be postponed
